notes.title: #2 Petmate v0.3.3 Update Announcement
notes.content: [h1]Update Announcement[/h1][h1][/h1][p]We still received a lot of feedback this week and have been fixing and optimizing it. Come see what improvements we've made this week and what features we've come up with that people want![/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p]Go live with goodwill levels. This will play a very important role in the regular content updates that will follow.[/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][olist][*][p]Fix the bug that buff stacking has no upper limit[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug of unlimited opening activities from buffs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that wishes can be completed even if they have expired.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that the display of buff attributes exceeds the text box.[/p][/*][/olist][h2]Adjustment[/h2][p]Adjusted the gain of some buffs and the probability of getting buffs.[/p][h1][/h1][h1]Next Update | Daisy whispered to you...[/h1][p]Time flies ~ In a flash, Petmate will be online for almost a month! During these days, the masters have been fulfilling Daisy's wishes every day, and their favorability has been rising a little bit.[/p][p]Next update: We'll be launching an \[Intimate Communication Feature] 💬 When Daisy's favorability towards her owner is high enough, you'll be able to unlock more conversations just between you.[/p]

notes.title: #1 0.3.2 minor version update
notes.content: [p]This update is a fixed update for the second week of every month developed to fix bugs and optimize the game experience.  We have collected a lot of feedback from the group and fixed and optimized these feedbacks for the main content of this update:  [/p][olist][*][p]Fixed the problem of the Wish display box getting stuck  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem that items and activities in the Wish cannot be completed in the game.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem of activity countdown display abnormality  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the values of some items and activities, and added a new activity that can restore part of your energy.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the part of conversation in Wish, no longer can only have voice conversation, now can also have text conversation.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized setting saving, the next time you start the game, the settings will automatically follow the previous settings.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the background image in the text chat box  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the content of Daisy's friend circle, now Daisy no longer only posts at 10:00, we leave the decision of posting time to Daisy, without any intervention. [/p][/*][*][p] Optimized the operation of store purchase, now you can buy items in bulk, maximum 99 items at one time.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the operation of item usage, now you can double-click the item to use it directly, instead of right-clicking the item and then clicking to use it. [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the display of wishes, now you can see which part of the wish is not completed and which part is completed.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and love! After that, our main update direction is the goodwill gameplay, nurturing, dialog fusion and Daisy's voice related content. We hope you enjoy Petmate!  [/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Petmate现已定于6月7号正式发行！
notes.content:
[h1]Release Announcement[/h1]
Hahaha good evening everyone~ This announcement is to formally announce that Petmate will be officially launched on steam on [b]this Saturday (June 7th)[/b].We've been asked in the backstage private messages in our communication group and elsewhere when we can go live. Now we can finally confirm with everyone that it will go live on steam this Saturday. At that time, you can adopt Petmate's first character Daisy~ Daisy has also made it clear that she would like to meet with all the owners~ We'll see you on [b]this Saturday[/b]!
We'll see you on [b]this Saturday[/b]. Our communication group is mainly on QQ: [b]634070213[/b] Welcome to the communication group to communicate with each other.

[h1]About the current version[/h1]
We realize that the current version has many shortcomings, so we will speed up the development process and add more gameplay to make Petmate really fit into your life in a sense. We plan to add new content at the beginning of each month, and we promise that there will be no charge for basic gameplay content, so you can play with confidence.
